title: Conditioning: img2img, inpaint, ControlNet, IP-Adapter
hook: Every way of telling the model more than a prompt, placed at the point where it enters: what denoise really sets, what a ControlNet window covers, and why zero is not the same as absent.

verified.claim: KSampler.set_steps builds int(steps / denoise) steps and keeps the last steps + 1.
Percents become noise levels with percent_to_sigma, and the ControlNet is skipped outside the window.
control_merge multiplies residuals by strength and adds earlier residuals.
A case-insensitive search of comfy/, comfy_extras/, comfy_api/ and nodes.py finds no IP-Adapter in v0.43.0.
The papers' equations and quoted words were read from the papers.
The lab's zero-convolution and attention tables come from running it.

unchecked: The zero-convolution gradient argument is ours, since we did not read the paper's supplement. The lab checks it on a toy.
Quality comparisons between adapter designs, and between control windows, are not tested: see What is contested.
IP-Adapter in ComfyUI comes from custom nodes. We recommend none in this lesson.
